Screen checkConfirm in Vanderbilt's Oracle or UKG during a recorded demo: Promote and Promote and Change Position both appear in Our Workforce > Quick Actions for HCMs; Vanderbilt promotion action reasons; Whether a promotion salary needs Compensation approval or a memo; Whether HCMs are expected to use Promote and Change Position or request position changes separately.

1 · Intro

When to use it.

A promotion moves an employee to a higher job and usually changes pay. In Oracle, Promote updates the assignment, salary, and payroll details; Promote and Change Position also changes the position in the same transaction.

Who submits depends on how the promotion happened: through a requisition or not.

Use this whenAn employee is moving up to a higher job, with or without a posted requisition.

2 · Walk through

Step by step.

Follow along in Oracle HCM. Check off each step as you go.

Watch-outs

  • After a position change, person type, location, working hours, and hourly salary do not flow from the position. Check them on the assignment.
  • Moving someone to a different position in your business unit at the same level is a transfer, not a promotion or Change Assignment.
  • Open item: confirm Vanderbilt's promotion action reasons and any Compensation approval needed for the new salary.

Official documentation

Vendor documentation describes the standard process. Vanderbilt's setup, codes, and rules in this course take priority.

  • Oracle: Redwood Experience for Promote Process (24A) (opens in a new tab)
  • Oracle: New Redwood Process to Promote and Change Position (24A) (opens in a new tab)

3 · Knowledge check

Check your understanding.

Three questions. You get feedback on each answer. All three right completes the course.

Q1An employee was promoted after applying to a requisition in Oracle Recruiting. Who processes the promotion?

Q2The new job needs the position itself updated. Which action do you use?

Q3After moving the person to the new position, what must you still check by hand?

HCM Academy job aid · Assignment Changes

Promote

Use when: An employee is moving up to a higher job, with or without a posted requisition. · System: Oracle HCM

  1. Check who processes it: requisition or no requisition.
    • Requisition: PCB Internal TA
    • No requisition: you submit
  2. Confirm the target position exists with the correct six-digit job code.
  3. Pick the action: Promote or Promote and Change Position.
  4. Open it from Our Workforce > Quick Actions and select the person.
  5. Enter When and why: effective date and promotion reason.
  6. Update the assignment and the salary.
  7. Review, submit, and track approval.

Watch-outs

  • After a position change, person type, location, working hours, and hourly salary do not flow from the position. Check them on the assignment.
  • Moving someone to a different position in your business unit at the same level is a transfer, not a promotion or Change Assignment.
  • Open item: confirm Vanderbilt's promotion action reasons and any Compensation approval needed for the new salary.
